newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-MARSH GIVES VOTE OF CONFIDENCE TO TAYLOR.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-MARSH GIVES VOTE OF CONFIDENCE TO TAYLOR.

text.p: Beleaguered Australian captain Mark Taylor received a vote of confidence from coach Geoff Marsh on Monday just three days before the first Ashes test against England.
Taylor, who has not scored a test half-century since 1995, was dismissed for 63 against Derbyshire on Monday in his final innings before the Edgbaston match.
"We'll sit down after this game with the three selectors and pick the best side to win the test match and I'm sure he'll be there," Marsh said.
Former Australian captains Ian and Greg Chappell have both called for Taylor's dismissal in favour of vice-captain Steve Waugh.
Marsh, Taylor and Waugh are the tour selectors.
